rows.passage: Operating profit after tax for the quarter was Rs. 4,951.5 million, margin of 10.6% with a year-on-year growth of 5%. We incurred transaction costs worth Rs. 1,853.4 million towards the Nagarro acquisition in this quarter. These expenses include transaction and advisory costs related to regulatory filing, financing charges, legal, communication and travel expenses. Over the next two quarters, we expect an incremental amount ranging between USD 25 to 30 million to be incurred towards the Nagarro transaction. For Q2 FY27, these expenses impacted the reported PAT margin as well as the reported EPS by around 3.1%. Reported profit after tax for the quarter was Rs. 3,515.1 million, a margin of 7.5%, with year-on-year decline of 25.4%. Operating earnings per share was Rs. 31.6 with a year-on-year growth of 4.2%, whereas the reported earnings per share was at Rs. 22.4 which translates into decline of 26%.
